description: This file is the main entry point (`Program.cs`) for a .NET application that handles executing SQL migrations (similar to Flyway), specifically for Postgres databases. It includes logic for parsing command-line arguments, loading environment variables from a `.env` file, discovering migration scripts, connecting to the database, ensuring the migration history table exists, and executing pending migrations within transactions. The code is organized into nested classes and static methods, with detailed comments describing the migration process, configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main entry point class for the migration runner application, containing the static Main method and helper functions for argument parsing and environment setup.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsRequest
classes.description: Immutable record representing the parameters required to run migrations, including connection info, migrations directory, and dry-run flag.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsResult
classes.description: Immutable record capturing the result of a migration run: counts of applied and skipped migrations.

classes.name: MigrationFile
classes.description: Represents a discovered migration script, with its version, description, and file info.

classes.name: MigrationDiscovery
classes.description: Static utility class for discovering and parsing migration files following Flyway-style naming conventions in a directory.

classes.name: MigrationChecksum
classes.description: Helper class for computing SHA256 checksums of SQL migration scripts.

classes.name: MigrationHistory
classes.description: Provides methods to query and insert records into the migration history table in the database.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: Utility class to parse PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL format into an Npgsql-compatible connection string.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Asynchronous entry point of the application that coordinates the migration process.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a `.env` file if it exists, to support local secrets.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an `ApplyMigrationsRequest` object, resolving paths and environment variables.

methods.name: ResolveMigrationsPath
methods.description: Determines the full path to the migrations directory based on input or default locations.

methods.name: PrintHelp
methods.description: Outputs help information about the CLI usage.

methods.name: NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Cleans up environment variable values by trimming and removing quotes.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Main method executing the migration process: connecting to DB, discovering scripts, checking applied versions, executing pending migrations, and recording history.

methods.name: ResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Chooses the appropriate connection string based on request parameters, preferring environment variables.

methods.name: EnsureHistoryTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the migrations history table if it does not exist.

methods.name: ExecuteSqlAsync
methods.description: Executes a SQL string within a given transaction.

methods.name: ComputeSha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 checksum of a given string and returns its hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers and parses migration files matching Flyway conventions, ordering them properly.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a filename into a migration descriptor based on naming conventions.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes version strings for proper sorting.

methods.name: GetAppliedVersionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the set of migration versions already applied from the database.

methods.name: InsertAppliedAsync
methods.description: Records a migration as successfully applied in the database history table.

methods.name: ToAdoLikeConnectionString
methods.description: Converts a PostgreSQL URL into an Npgsql-compatible connection string, parsing user info, host, port, and query parameters.
